case_name: The State By Kamakshipalya vs A1. Srinath

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: The State by Kamakshipalya (Police Station, Bengaluru)
parties.respondent_defendant: A1. Srinath, s/o Ravichandran, and others

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage of complainant with accused on 06.09.2009; demand for dowry and lease amount; prosecution alleges cruelty and harassment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the demand for dowry was not made.
legal_principles.held: It is the specific case of the prosecution that, the marriage of the complainant was took place alongwith the accused on 06.09.2009 as per the Hindu rites and customs.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the totality of circumstances to determine whether a demand for dowry was made.
legal_principles.held: During the marriage negotiation since the accused No.1 was working in a reputed company, the accused demanded with the CW2 and CW4 to give 60 savaran gold ornaments as dowry.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: No relief granted to the complainant

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: assisting with maintenance and alimony disputes
